unsetEffects.defaultPolicy: New cards are open — the board or any agent can respond, including the one that asked.
unsetEffects.cap: A request keeps whatever audience it asks for.

defaultPolicyEffects.notCreator: New cards exclude the agent that created them, so the answer comes from someone else.
defaultPolicyEffects.humanOnly: New cards wait for a person on the board. Agents are turned away.

capEffects.notCreator: Even a card that asks for Anyone is narrowed to exclude its creator.
capEffects.humanOnly: Every card of this kind waits for a person, whatever it asked for.

interaction-governance-panel.title: Interaction governance
interaction-governance-panel.intro: Thread interactions are open by default: <0>Anyone</0> in the organization — the board or any agent, including the one that asked — can respond. Narrow a kind only when you need to. <1>Default policy</1> is the audience new cards get when the requester does not ask for one; <2>Cap</2> narrows every request of that kind and can never widen one. Tool-approval confirmations always stay <3>Human only</3>.

kindHeadline.missingDisposition: This task's run finished, but no next step was chosen. Choose what happens next — try the task again, mark it done, or send it for review.
kindHeadline.deliberateWaitWithoutTarget: This task's last run stopped to wait, but there is no reviewer, blocker, monitor, or approval to wait for. Myrmidon is repairing the next step; the task stays with its owner.
kindHeadline.strandedAssignedIssue: Myrmidon retried this task's last run, but there is still no queued run, reviewer, blocker, or other next owner. To get it moving, choose what happens next — try the task again, mark it done, or send it for review.
kindHeadline.workspaceValidation: Myrmidon stopped this run because the task's git workspace could not be validated.
kindHeadline.configurationValidation: Myrmidon stopped before dispatching this run because required secret/env bindings are missing.
kindHeadline.activeRunWatchdog: The active run has been silent. Recovery is observing without interrupting it.
kindHeadline.issueGraphLiveness: Myrmidon could not find a clear next step for this open task. Choose whether to continue work, send it for review, mark it done, or record what is blocking it.

issue-recovery-action-card.humanDecisionHeadline: This recovery needs a human decision. Review the recorded failure and choose the next step.
issue-recovery-action-card.worktreeClaimed: Worktree claimed by <0>{{claimant}}</0> {{state}} — the lossless repair can't run while another workspace holds the live branch.
issue-recovery-action-card.breakGlassDescription: This overrides Myrmidon's safety check and points the recorded workspace at the live branch <0>without an ancestry proof</0>. Confirm the divergence below and record why before continuing.
issue-recovery-action-card.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Verified the live branch carries only the intended follow-up commits; safe to adopt.
issue-recovery-action-card.repairTrigger: Repair workspace — quarantine changes & restore branch
issue-recovery-action-card.repairDescription: This is lossless — no reason required. Your uncommitted changes are committed onto a fresh rescue branch, then the recorded branch is restored so the task can resume. The live branch is left exactly as it is.

wake.wakeOwner: An agent will be asked to choose the next step
wake.boundedOwnerDispositionRepair: Myrmidon is retrying the original owner
wake.boundedRecoveryOwner: A recovery owner is repairing the next step
wake.retryExpired: The scheduled retry did not run — a retry or a decision is needed
wake.retriesFinished: Automatic retries are finished — a decision is needed

lineageHeadline.retryExpired: This task's automatic retry came due and did not run, so nothing is moving it forward right now. Someone must retry it or record the next step. The task stays with its original owner.
lineageHeadline.sourceOwnerExhausted: This task's last run stopped to wait, but nothing was waiting for it. The original owner has used every automatic repair attempt, so the next step needs a decision. The task stays with its owner.
lineageHeadline.sourceOwnerRetrying: This task's last run stopped to wait, but nothing was waiting for it. Myrmidon is retrying the original owner to record a real next step. The task stays with its owner, and no action is needed yet.
lineageHeadline.recoveryOwner: The original owner could not record a next step within its retry budget. A recovery owner is now repairing the path only — the task itself still belongs to its original owner.
lineageHeadline.board: Automatic recovery is exhausted, so the board must choose the next step. The task itself still belongs to its original owner.
